tasks.prompt: Summarise for a v1.35 contributor what Code Freeze means: when it starts, what must be ready by then, what can still merge, and which labels a PR needs.

rubric.text: Code Freeze (with Test Freeze) starts in week 8: Thursday 6th November 2025 AoE, i.e. Friday 7th November 2025 12:00 UTC (not the earlier week 7 date).
Enhancement PRs, including tests, must be merge-ready with approved and lgtm labels; docs PRs must be opened but need not be ready to merge.
After that, only PRs related to release-blocking issues in the milestone may proceed.
PRs need /milestone v1.35, /sig, /kind bug or failing-test, /lgtm and /approved.
priority/important-soon issues are moved out of the milestone at Code Freeze after a 4-day grace period.
